spec.provenance: Strontium optical lattice clock, space-oriented goal sigma_y(1s)=1e-15 (Origlia/Schiller/Bongs et al., arXiv:1503.08457); q_wf=sigma_y(1s)^2; ground-demonstrator maturity, not flown; flicker/aging not modeled
Microchip SA65 / SA.45s CSAC datasheet sigma_y(1s)=3e-10; q_wf=sigma_y(1s)^2; flicker/aging not modeled

classical.adev_curve[].adev.note: overlapping Allan deviation sigma_y(tau) of the clock phase — a dimensionless fractional-frequency stability

classical.adev_curve[].ci_hi.note: upper end of the chi-squared 95% confidence interval on adev at this tau

classical.adev_curve[].ci_lo.note: lower end of the chi-squared 95% confidence interval on adev at this tau

classical.adev_curve[].edf.note: effective degrees of freedom of this point for the power-law noise type identified over the whole record

classical.adev_curve[].n_samples.note: number of overlapping second differences averaged into this point

classical.adev_curve[].tau_s.note: averaging time of this overlapping-Allan point, m*time.step_s at octave-spaced m

classical.filter_health.nees_chi2_lower_.note: lower 95% chi-squared acceptance bound on the NEES mean, chi2_0.025(2*seeds)/seeds

classical.filter_health.nees_chi2_upper_.note: upper 95% chi-squared acceptance bound on the NEES mean, chi2_0.975(2*seeds)/seeds

classical.filter_health.nees_mean.note: pooled mean normalised estimation error squared; a matched two-state filter gives 2

classical.filter_health.nis_chi2_lower_9.note: lower 95% chi-squared acceptance bound on the NIS mean, chi2_0.025(K)/K over K pooled innovations

classical.filter_health.nis_chi2_upper_9.note: upper 95% chi-squared acceptance bound on the NIS mean, chi2_0.975(K)/K over K pooled innovations

classical.filter_health.nis_mean.note: pooled mean normalised innovation squared over the consistency ensemble; a matched filter gives 1

classical.fom.availability.note: fraction of all samples in the run whose absolute timing error is within threshold_ns

classical.fom.holdover_s.note: worst-case (shortest) in-spec coast across the outage segments; grid-bounded at time.step_s

classical.fom.integrity.note: filter self-consistency: the fraction of outage samples whose true error stays inside the Kalman 3-sigma phase bound; not an aviation HPL/VPL/RAIM integrity figure

classical.fom.resilience_slope_ns_per_s.note: least-squares slope of the absolute timing error against time over the outage

classical.fom.security.note: analytic spoof-detectability bound from clock stability, clamp(1 - smallest detectable offset / threshold_ns, 0, 1); meaningful only against a configured attack, and not a multi-satellite RAIM detector

classical.fom.timing_p95_ns.note: 95th percentile (nearest-rank) of the absolute timing error over the outage samples

classical.fom.timing_rms_ns.note: root mean square of the timing error over the outage samples

classical.series[].error_ns.note: timing error at t: the true clock phase minus the coasted prediction; zero while GNSS is nominal

classical.series[].t.note: sample time on the uniform run grid, i*time.step_s

classical.spec.params.drift.note: linear fractional-frequency aging rate: the deterministic frequency is y0 + drift*t

classical.spec.params.flicker_floor.note: flat flicker-FM Allan-deviation floor sigma_y of the clock model; null when no flicker component is configured

classical.spec.params.q_rw.note: random-walk-FM process-noise intensity: the fractional frequency gains variance q_rw*dt over a step dt

classical.spec.params.q_wf.note: white-FM process-noise intensity: the clock phase gains variance q_wf*dt over a step dt, so q_wf is numerically sigma_y(1 s)^2

classical.spec.params.y0.note: deterministic fractional-frequency offset of the clock model (dimensionless df/f)

eci_track[][].note: one Earth-centred-inertial [x, y, z] component of the propagated user spacecraft at one sampled time; emitted only by the orbit pack, absent from a clock run
